description: This file is a shell script that automates the startup, setup, and configuration of a MongoDB instance, including environment setup, user creation, and connection instructions.

methods.name: mongosh
methods.description: MongoDB shell command used to evaluate JavaScript and interact with the database.

methods.name: sudo mongod
methods.description: Runs the MongoDB server process with root privileges.

methods.name: pgrep
methods.description: Utility to find process IDs based on process name.

methods.name: lsof
methods.description: Lists open files, used here to identify MongoDB's port.

methods.name: pkill
methods.description: Kills processes by name, used here to stop running MongoDB instances.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes socket files and other temp files.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses script execution for specified seconds.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Outputs text to console as part of process and status messages.
